summary: In the Name of the People is a 2000 American television movie drama released by CBS Productions and Jaffe/Braunstein Films. The film was shot in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. It was adapted from a play by Tim Boland.
one_line: A 2000 American TV movie drama, produced by CBS Productions and Jaffe/Braunstein Films and based on a play by Tim Boland.
key_facts: In the Name of the People is an American television movie drama.
In the Name of the People was released in 2000.
In the Name of the People was released by CBS Productions and Jaffe/Braunstein Films.
In the Name of the People was filmed in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.
In the Name of the People was based on the play by Tim Boland.
